lens: Product systems and reliability — overall coherence
reason: The Precision Instrument presentation is coherent: the supplied public captures make the proposition and two audience actions clear, and distinguish named organizations from case studies awaiting approval. I traced the student journey from Join preparation through application recovery, submission and applicant status in source and synthetic tests. Recovery comparison, revision conflicts, partial-versus-valid evaluation coverage, irreversible grading confirmation, and release-versus-email receipts show substantial care. The synthetic mobile close dialog communicates consequences and real count definitions clearly. However, application submission drops the explicit receipt-validation discipline used elsewhere and can discard recovery on an unverified success response. This prevents unqualified world-class agreement. This is an independent AI source/capture assessment, not observed applicant/operator success or human endorsement. No staging or hosted acceptance exists.

findings.evidence: submit() calls finishSubmission() for every response.ok without parsing its body (530-538). finishSubmission clears both recovery keys and redirects with submitted=1 (493-501). The API contract returns { applicationId } (src/app/api/apply/route.ts:102-112). tests/e2e/application-reliability.spec.ts:64-80 explicitly supplies HTTP 200 with {} and expects the success redirect; the malformed-receipt rejection at 342-349 covers draft saves only.
findings.userImpact: An empty, malformed or redirected successful response is treated as confirmed submission, removing the local recovery copy despite lacking the application receipt. This is a source-proven acceptance gap; no hosted occurrence was observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Validate a nonempty applicationId receipt before clearing recovery. Treat invalid success bodies or unexpected redirects as uncertain; reconcile submitted status and preserve answers unless confirmed. Replace the empty-success fixture with a valid receipt and add malformed/HTML success cases that retain recovery.

notVerified: Actual Clerk session expiry, Supabase RPC/RLS and storage behavior, provider provisioning, email delivery and coordinated migration/application rollout; local SQL and intercepted HTTP do not establish these integrations.

Real applicants or operators completing recovery, grading close or decision release. The close snapshot is explicitly advisory: counts can change before freeze; operator understanding and concurrent hosted behavior remain unobserved.

Original-resume access is disclosed in Materials and Review; Board resolution of the older anonymous-review promise, privacy retention decisions and client-approved project artifacts remain external dependencies.

Physical devices, Safari, Firefox, assistive technology and formal accessibility conformance. Public screenshots use Linux font fallback; the operator capture is synthetic, and private recovery/release screens were source/test reviewed.
